rationale: The theft from the customer's shoulder is covered under Baggage and Personal Effects (wording section 5), and the police report was made within 24 hours as required. Electronics Plus raises the limit only for the electronics listed in section 8 (the e-reader), so the headphones and game console take the Premium per-item limit of $300, and the tote ($95) and the e-reader ($180) are paid in full: $300 + $180 + $300 + $95 = $875, less the $50 Premium deductible, for $825 (payout limits per manual section 6 and wording section 10). The payout is under the $1,000 approval limit, so no sign-off is needed.
